stages.name: Morphological Segmentation (Wakachi-gaki 分かち書き)
stages.algorithm: Viterbi search over UniDic word lattice using node and connection cost matrix
stages.output: Short-Unit Words (SUW) with byte offsets and script classification

stages.name: Parts-of-Speech Tagging (品詞推定)
stages.algorithm: BiLSTM-CRF or Transformer-based sequence labeling against UniDic / MeCab tagsets
stages.output: Hierarchical Hinshi labels + Katsuyou form and base lemma

stages.name: Bunsetsu Chunking & Dependency Parsing (文節係り受け解析)
stages.algorithm: Head-final tournament model (CaboCha / KNP style) with shift-reduce transitions
stages.output: Directed acyclic dependency tree enforcing modifier-head precedence

stages.name: Named Entity Recognition (固有表現抽出)
stages.algorithm: Context-aware token classification with suffix heuristic triggers (株式会社, さん, 県, 市)
stages.output: PERSON, ORG, GPE, DATE, TECH spans

stages.name: Zero-Pronoun Resolution (ゼロ代名詞・項省略同定)
stages.algorithm: Topic-chain tracking + predicate honorific/giving-verb concord resolution
stages.output: Null subject/object link to active discourse antecedent

stages.name: Semantic Role Labeling (述語項構造解析 PAS)
stages.algorithm: Particle-case grid mapping (が=Agent, を=Patient, に=Goal)
stages.output: PAS propositional frames with confidence scores

pipeline_architecture.uncertainty_propagation: Confidence logits and entropy scores are preserved at each stage and forwarded to downstream tasks.
